newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 15.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 15.

text.p: - All Mexican ports were open on Thursday to larger ships, although approaching storms in the Gulf of Mexico threatened to interrupt the calm, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1500 local/2000 GMT daily meteorological report.
A weak cold front was reportedly heading toward the Gulf of Mexico, and expected to bring lower temperatures and stronger winds to the region by later in the day.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.
Clear skies and warm temperatures with winds from 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) and waves four to six feet high.
Approaching cold front expected to hit the region later in the day. Winds at 10 to 20 knots (19 to 38 km/11 to 22 feet high with strong gusts along Veracruz, Tabasco and Tamaulipas coasts.
Hot and partly cloudy with some rains and winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
